caption: Key nutritional factors for foods for canine and feline cancer patients.
rows:
Avoid excess digestible carbohydrate
NFE = ≤25% DM or <20% of the food's ME

Provide a large proportion of energy from fat
Fat = 25 to 40% of DM or 50 to 65% of the food's ME
Provide foods with increased levels of omega-3 fatty acids (>5% DM)
Provide foods with an omega-6:omega-3 ratio as close to 1:1 as possible

Avoid protein deficiency
Provide protein in excess of adult requirements
Dogs: protein = 30 to 45% of DM or 25 to 40% of the food's ME
Cats: protein = 40 to 50% of DM or 35 to 45% of the food's ME
(Taurine is always a necessary inclusion in feline diets)
Provide foods with arginine DM levels >2%
note: *Key: NFE = nitrogen-free extract, DM = dry matter, ME = metabolizable energy.
